Comment: Cust-order-fufillment scenario - converts a reserved cart into a placed order. Calls the PaymentFlow sub-flow, deducts the blocked stock on success and routes to the OrderFulfillment sub-flow. On a declined payment it releases the blocked stock and fails with OrderPaymentFailed.

PayForOrder.Comment: Sub-flow: charge card, generate PDF receipt, email it to the customer.

ReleaseBlockedStock.Comment: Payment failed - unblock the stock so it is available to other carts.

OrderFailed.Cause: Payment declined; blocked stock was released and the order was not placed

DeductStock.Comment: Converts the reservation into a real stock deduction (order is now committed).

RouteToFulfillment.Comment: Sub-flow: business rules pick the carrier and schedule a pickup.
